form_cues: Hold the dumbbell vertically at chest height
Keep your chest tall and core braced
Drive knees out over toes
Sink hips below parallel for full depth
routine.sourceQuote: We're starting with goblet squats — hold that dumbbell vertically right at your chest

form_cues: Hinge at the hips, not the lower back
Keep a slight bend in the knee
Feel the hamstring stretch before you drive back up
Control the lowering phase for 3 counts
routine.sourceQuote: Hinge at the hips — you want to feel it in your hamstrings, not your lower back

form_cues: Step forward with control, not momentum
Front knee tracks directly over the toes
Back knee barely touches the floor
exercises.sourceQuote: Superset time — lunges into split squats

form_cues: Rear foot elevated on bench or chair
Most of the weight on the front leg
Sit straight down rather than forward
exercises.sourceQuote: Now Bulgarian split squats — this will burn

form_cues: Wide stance, toes angled out at 45 degrees
Hold one dumbbell vertically between your legs
Squeeze the inner thighs and glutes at the top
routine.sourceQuote: Wide stance sumo squat — targets the inner thighs and glutes

form_cues: Hold dumbbells at sides for added resistance
Rise up slowly onto the balls of your feet
Pause at the top for a full calf contraction
Lower under control, feel the stretch
routine.sourceQuote: Finish with calf raises — don't skip calves, they're part of your leg day
